title: Step 64-G customer Returns and Warranty request/detail/timeline/recovery
description: HIGH-risk Step 64-G. Productionize SF-E-11 /account/returns/:returnNumber? and SF-E-12 /account/warranty/:claimNumber? using only the canonical customer-owned Returns/Warranty contracts repaired in Stage 64-B. Support bounded creation, list/detail/timeline recovery and customer return cancellation only where current runtime permits it. Do not invent eligibility, upload/evidence, refund/replacement authority, admin transitions, payment actions, or Step 64-H+ behavior.

dependencies.evidence: PR #326 merged; exact merge-SHA Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality and CodeQL succeeded; terminal Lock released.

acceptance_criteria.description: SF-E-11 /account/returns/:returnNumber? and SF-E-12 /account/warranty/:claimNumber? are productionized and no longer use RoutePlaceholder.

Returns use only canonical customer-owned list/detail/timeline/create/cancel operations. Creation submits one or more valid owned order-item requests under the selected order; customer cancellation is exposed only for current requested state and rechecks the owned return before mutation.
Warranty uses only canonical customer-owned list/detail/timeline/create operations and never exposes admin review/receive/repair/resolve/close authority to Storefront.
Create/cancel mutations use required Idempotency-Key, validated bounded input and fail-closed unknown outcomes. 401 clears personal presentation; 403/404 do not disclose another customer's record.
Detail remains authoritative when timeline loading fails; no browser-local after-sales truth, optimistic success or inferred eligibility is introduced.
Return and Warranty customer timelines render only bounded canonical status/reason/timestamp fields. Unknown additionalProperties and raw internal fields are not rendered as authority.
No upload/evidence workflow, refund amount, replacement decision, staff transition, payment mutation, shipping mutation or unsupported eligibility rule is invented.
Customer session cookies remain server-only through CustomerSessionBridge; no token/session/browser-storage authority is introduced.
Persian RTL UI provides list/create/detail/timeline/error/empty/pending/terminal states, 44px targets, visible focus, bidi-isolated references and narrow/400% reflow without brown palette additions.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate, protected merge, exact-merge-SHA verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: HIGH-risk Stage 64-G requires Project Owner approval only after the exact artifact has passed provider checks, Security, deterministic Review and ACTIVE Lock.
